incidents-bot: ALERT: Reports of duplicated embedding billing units and occasional duplicate responses for embeddings. Investigating. Live status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2080012345-embed-metering-dup

nisha-sre: Seeing duplicate events land in the metering topic from telemetry producers under elevated backpressure. Dup rate ~0.9% in ap-southeast-1.

tom-telemetry: Rolling telemetry producer back to v1.7.2 and pausing non-critical producers now. Canary started ap-southeast-1a. ETA ~8m.

jade-billing: Pausing invoice run for the affected ingestion window and flagging potential credits. Billing hold id: bh-2080012345.

anya-support: Drafted customer message pinned in #support-ops: "Were investigating duplicated embedding usage and have paused billing for the impacted window. We will apply credits where duplicates are confirmed. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2080012345-embed-metering-dup"

nisha-sre: Mitigations so far:
- 2080012405: paused non-critical telemetry producers
- 2080012420: rollback started (canary)
- scheduled dedupe backfill (job id dedupe-2080012345) after rollback

tom-telemetry: Canary rollback healthy at 2080012480; duplicate rate down ~75% there. Rolling across zones in 2 waves.

jade-billing: Finance will reconcile and apply credits automatically once dedupe completes. Expect preliminary list in ~40m.

anya-support: Support copy (quick): "Thanks  we detected duplicated embedding events and paused billing for the window. We will credit affected accounts after reconciliation. If youre still seeing duplicates please attach request IDs and examples. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2080012345-embed-metering-dup"

nisha-sre: Current status: rollback in progress and dedupe queued. Expect most symptoms to resolve within 30-60m. Next update in 20m or on major change.
